# Back40

> Free decision tools for cow-calf ranchers. Change any number and every answer updates on the spot. Nothing to install; numbers stay in your browser.

Starting values come from the Beef Cattle Decision Aids spreadsheets and reproduce their assumptions, not real producer data. Check every number against your own before deciding.

## Tools
- [Cow decisions](https://back40agtools.com/cow-decisions/): budgets for what to pay for a bred cow, what calf price you need, whether to raise a replacement heifer, and when to sell or keep.
- [Herd calculators](https://back40agtools.com/herd-tools/): water, ration mix, dewormer dose and withdrawal, weight gain, and herd reproduction.
- [My Ranch](https://back40agtools.com/my-ranch/): draw pastures on a map, get carrying capacity from USDA soil data, and match the herd to the grass.

## Sources and privacy
- [Where the prices come from](https://back40agtools.com/data-sources.html): every price and number with its source.
- [Privacy and your data](https://back40agtools.com/privacy.html)
